description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Same rules as the dashboard: only the assigned approver may decide. On a "workflow" approval, decision "approve" resumes the parked run, whose next steps may publish (GOES LIVE); "reject" cancels it. On a "manual" approval, "approve" only marks the content approved — nothing is posted until you call publish with its contentId — and "reject" returns it to draft. Needs the explicit `approve` scope (admin does not include it). Agency plan. Repeating the same decision is safe (alreadyDecided: true). Confirm with the user before approving a workflow approval.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/approvals/{id}.)
name: decide_approval
title: Approve or reject held content
